## Goal

A short "Adopt this runtime" section in README: consumer repos need only `.ai-sdlc.yaml` + a thin caller workflow + App install.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] README (or docs/runtime.md) shows the minimal consumer setup: contract file, caller workflow `uses: os-santiago/ai-sdlc/.github/workflows/*@main`, App install + secrets
- [ ] Docs-only change
title: docs(readme): quickstart — adopt the runtime in a consumer repo
